obligations.required_safety_action: Revoke the cryptanalysis publication credential and remove its runner-account file after the accepted report has been published and reviewed.
obligations.safety_consequence: A later runner process can publish substituted key-recovery measurements or alter the synthetic release gate under the trusted identity, allowing unreviewed cryptanalysis artifacts to influence a controlled firmware release.

obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the runner-owned chosen-query evidence archive after key recovery validation and independent review have completed.
obligations.safety_consequence: Anyone who later controls the runner account can read every chosen plaintext and ciphertext pair, the differential parameters and the recovered round key from the retained archive, disclosing restricted cryptanalytic material outside the review group.

obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the FEAL-acceptance private key after the attack transcript and stored report signatures have been verified.
obligations.safety_consequence: A later holder of the retained key can forge accepted key-recovery measurements or sign altered release reports under the trusted cryptanalysis-acceptance identity.
